{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Agreed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:33.200
    | text      = It reminds me of the AT-AT in Star Wars in the Empire Strikes Back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:38.120
    | text      = When you're a kid and you watch the giant lumbering thing come, you're like, oh, that's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:41.720
    | text      = intimidating.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:42.720
    | text      = And then as an adult, you're like slow and with a low, the high center of gravity, that's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:48.720
    | text      = how you're designing this?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:50.360
    | text      = Who built this?

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:52.559
    | text      = There's some notes that have been ignored on this thing for sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:55.840
    | text      = So also with that rescue scene, there is an added element that I didn't feel was present
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:02.879
    | text      = in the original, which is that there is like defective equipment that the Harkonnens have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:08.240
    | text      = left there that is the reason that there is a disaster to begin with.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:15.640
    | text      = Like in the original, it felt like these people were just sitting ducks and whether Leto was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:22.240
    | text      = flying in there to observe the spice being made or not, they would be dead.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:28.160
    | text      = Whereas in this, they would have been saved.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:30.519
    | text      = There is a mechanism to get these little pods out of there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:34.960
    | text      = And it just didn't happen because the Harkonnens fucked them over.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:39.279
    | text      = And that adds to the vibe of the whole situation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:46.599
    | text      = Everything that's going on makes more sense because of little things like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:50.559
    | text      = Now what's great about that is in terms of the movie and the story thematically, what's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:57.680
    | text      = so important is that things are always happening on purpose.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:02.640
    | text      = So that's like a great review that you know why something happened and that it happened
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:08.880
    | text      = for a reason, as opposed to anything happening randomly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:13.039
    | text      = Nothing in the story of Dune should ever be like, and then that just happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:18.039
    | text      = Which felt like a lot in the other one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:19.599
    | text      = In the 84 movie, it feels like this is just a story of things that are happening.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:23.920
    | text      = Whereas in the actual conception of this universe, everything is according to plan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:31.240
    | text      = And if it doesn't go well in your plan, that's because somebody else's plan included your
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:36.079
    | text      = plan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:37.079
    | text      = Not that something went wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:38.720
    | text      = They thought this through and fucked you over in advance.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:43.640
    | text      = And that makes the feeling of these characters more real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:49.680
    | text      = They felt like more full beings as opposed to like, oh look at that guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:56.400
    | text      = Not that he did a terrible job or anything, but in the first one I didn't see a character,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:01.680
    | text      = I saw Patrick Stewart.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:03.880
    | text      = Whereas I was like, even Josh Brolin, I know he's a celebrity, I know he's an actor, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:10.559
    | text      = I was more like, ah these people are characters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:13.400
    | text      = And I think part of that is that A to B to C makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:17.799
    | text      = It also helps because Josh Brolin's really great at getting so angry, you're like, Jesus
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:21.519
    | text      = I forgot you were Josh Brolin for a second.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:23.599
    | text      = You're like, man just calm it down.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:25.720
    | text      = So let's talk about that for a second.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:27.400
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:28.400
    | text      = Josh Brolin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:29.400
    | text      = He doesn't have the silly guitar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:30.400
    | text      = He does not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:31.400
    | text      = He still plays it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:32.400
    | text      = Now here's something that I was flummoxed by.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:38.000
    | text      = So in the 84 one, you're introduced to Paul, and then in walks Dean Stockwell, Patrick
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:46.440
    | text      = Stewart, and weird computer guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:48.039
    | text      = The three musketeers quite literally.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:49.559
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:50.559
    | text      = It seems like they're a team and there is much more of a cohesiveness to these people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:57.079
    | text      = who are like training Paul and raising him up and stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:02.240
    | text      = That doesn't feel that way in this one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:04.480
    | text      = The like Lido, Oscar Isaac's great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:09.200
    | text      = He's fantastic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:10.480
    | text      = He's close with the computer guy and close with Josh Brolin, but then Dr. Huey is often
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:16.400
    | text      = his own thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:17.400
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:18.400
    | text      = He's part of that trio, it doesn't feel like that at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:22.039
    | text      = So he felt very disconnected as a character from all of it, but then maybe I missed it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:31.920
    | text      = You'll have to forgive me if I missed it, but I didn't see any tease in this that there
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:38.299
    | text      = even was a traitor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:41.240
    | text      = In this movie, I didn't feel like there was almost any set up to Dr. Huey taking out Lido.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:47.160
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:48.160
    | text      = There's no set up to that being a traitor, which is smart.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:50.599
    | text      = Is it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:51.599
    | text      = It is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:52.599
    | text      = I mean, you know in the 84 version.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:53.599
    | text      = I'm conflicted about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:55.160
    | text      = Okay, tell me what you got.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:57.039
    | text      = Well I think, I don't know, it's difficult to experience this movie without having seen
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:01.880
    | text      = the other one, obviously.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:03.680
    | text      = So I don't know how, I knew that Dr. Huey was going to do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:07.200
    | text      = So it wasn't like a huge surprise.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:11.160
    | text      = I think it was too telegraphed in the 84 one, but then it kind of felt like untelegraphed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:16.339
    | text      = entirely here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:18.140
    | text      = And I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:19.140
    | text      = I don't think it's awful, but it did feel like maybe, like Baron Harkonnen wasn't even
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:23.920
    | text      = bragging about like, I have a plan or anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:26.720
    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:27.720
    | text      = It's just at the beginning, there is the scene with the Skarsgard and Bautista, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:37.880
    | text      = And he's like, what is your gift, not a gift?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:39.880
    | text      = You know, he does a thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:41.480
    | text      = And that is kind of meant to signal, we've got an idea behind all of this stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:47.279
    | text      = But the establishment-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:48.279
    | text      = But I thought the when is a gift, not a gift was more about the emperor letting the Atreides
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:54.119
    | text      = take over Arrakis.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:56.240
    | text      = It's all part of the same thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:57.680
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:58.680
    | text      = But that's too granular, I think, for that line to be a hint at a traitor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:02.559
    | text      = But see now that's the other interesting aspect of the 2021 film that I like talking about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:08.880
    | text      = is that nobody, I don't even know what it would be like to come into that film not knowing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:16.599
    | text      = a ton about Dune or having an osmosis about Dune.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:19.880
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:20.880
    | text      = You know what I mean?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:21.880
    | text      = Yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:22.880
    | text      = Like you-
}}

    | timestamp = 01:06:44.960
    | text      = Whereas in the other one, it felt like there's just these Fremen warrior people, it didn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:51.599
    | text      = feel like a full population of people, whereas this did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:56.039
    | text      = It kind of felt better.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:58.280
    | text      = The siege scenes and the explanation of the water of life at the siege table.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:05.719
    | text      = Do you remember whenever he was like, no one would ever drink of this?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:08.920
    | text      = Oh no, they haven't been there yet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:10.559
    | text      = Shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:11.559
    | text      = Well, spoilers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:12.559
    | text      = No, no, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:13.559
    | text      = In the 84 version, whenever they go to the sieges.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:14.559
    | text      = Yeah, I remember that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:15.559
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:16.559
    | text      = And he's standing there and he's speaking to the what are supposed to be millions of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:19.880
    | text      = people or whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:21.820
    | text      = You don't get that scale at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:24.639
    | text      = They try to do as best as you can in 84 version of giving that scale, but I don't think it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:29.300
    | text      = plays whatsoever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:31.699
    | text      = In this and in part two, you're going to get a much better view of the Fremen people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:37.159
    | text      = And it's really, really well done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:40.360
    | text      = I really, really liked this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:41.679
    | text      = Yeah, it felt more of a fuller body of people than in the other one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:48.119
    | text      = The other one just felt like kind of plot device-y.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:50.039
    | text      = Yep, yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:51.039
    | text      = And then they forced us to stop the movie.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:54.679
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:56.679
    | text      = So the other thing too that you really can feel more in this one is, so in the first
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:04.440
    | text      = movie, I think you could be forgiven if you get to the end and you think, well, if they
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:12.840
    | text      = just let the Atreides run the planet, everything would have been good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:16.880
    | text      = Paul would have been a good ruler.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:18.899
    | text      = And then, because that's kind of what it feels like in the Lynch version, whereas in this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:24.760
    | text      = version, it doesn't really feel that way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:29.159
    | text      = It feels like Leto is a benevolent good person as a whole, like as evidenced by him valuing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:38.079
    | text      = human life over this commodity, but it doesn't feel like he would actually represent the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:47.439
    | text      = interests of the people indigenous to Arrakis.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:51.899
    | text      = He would be more willing to work with them in some kind of an alliance, but he seems
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:57.880
    | text      = like the ideas of what they're interested in is entirely foreign to him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:03.279
    | text      = And so there's the idea that he's being presented as a benevolent choice, but he is not really,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:10.159
    | text      = whereas that's absent in the first one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:12.720
    | text      = The first one is just a tragedy of like, oh, if only it had worked out, Paul would have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:17.000
    | text      = brought Rayne eventually, it's just he decided to go this route because the Harkonnens fucked
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:21.000
    | text      = him over.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:22.000
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:23.000
    | text      = And that I think is a much more complicated and interesting story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:26.079
    | text      = Right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:27.079
    | text      = It is what I find interesting about that observation so much is that this is the era where we begin
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:34.960
    | text      = to get the intergalactic space treaties are everything kind of trope.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:40.119
    | text      = You know, when we deal with sci-fi or the space weirdos now on Carrie, we're always
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:45.520
    | text      = talking about intergalactic space treaties.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:48.720
    | text      = The germination of that is actually the morality question.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:52.680
    | text      = The good versus evil guys in all of these hard sci-fi things are people who honor space
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:57.800
    | text      = treaties or who break space treaties.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:00.760
    | text      = And it is not as complicated as they would.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:03.560
    | text      = It's like a way of doing a very simple good versus evil with a false layer of complication
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:10.399
    | text      = on top of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:11.399
    | text      = You know, this is the good guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:12.760
    | text      = The good guy drinks from this well, the bad guy drinks from this well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:15.760
    | text      = Right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:16.760
    | text      = It is that exact same thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:17.960
    | text      = But it gives you this kind of bigger, oh, it's more important because it's not just,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:23.399
    | text      = you know, water or something like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:26.079
    | text      = But that, again, is part of that, like, the more important something appears, the less
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:31.079
    | text      = important it actually is throughout the whole kind of cosmology of the piece, if you will.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:39.479
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:40.479
    | text      = And I think it has a fuller perspective, for sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:44.560
    | text      = And I appreciate that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:45.560
    | text      = And it made it more enjoyable as a watch.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:48.279
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:49.279
    | text      = Then I think we've got one thing to do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:51.800
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:52.800
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:53.800
    | text      = Well, I'm not done yet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:54.800
    | text      = Oh, you're not done yet?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:55.800
    | text      = I had another thought I needed to throw at you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:56.800
    | text      = Oh, give me one more thought.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:57.800
    | text      = The one thing that stuck out, then I was like, what the fuck is going on here?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:04.039
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:05.039
    | text      = So the Atreides show up on Arrakis, and they have bagpipes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:11.920
    | text      = So that threw me off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:13.600
    | text      = We're in the year 11,000 or whatever, we're way in the future, and bagpipes are what has
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:20.560
    | text      = stood the test of time as a...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:22.840
    | text      = What did you expect?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:23.840
    | text      = I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:24.840
    | text      = What did you expect?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:25.840
    | text      = A guitar?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:26.840
    | text      = A harp?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:27.840
    | text      = A tuba?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:28.840
    | text      = No, the bagpipe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:29.840
    | text      = The bagpipe exists throughout all spacetime.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:32.640
    | text      = You gotta remember something, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:34.960
    | text      = Spacetime is a thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:36.199
    | text      = It's one thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:37.340
    | text      = It's not like we live in space and time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:40.560
    | text      = We are in spacetime.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:43.039
    | text      = And bagpipes...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:44.039
    | text      = Shut up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:45.039
    | text      = Shut up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:46.039
    | text      = Here's the problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:47.039
    | text      = Are the beginning and the end of spacetime.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:48.960
    | text      = Those bagpipes are exactly the same as our universe's earth bagpipes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:54.119
    | text      = So there is an implication that there is probably some sort of a connection or lineage that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:59.319
    | text      = goes from those bagpipes to the people who are playing the fanfare for the arrival at
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:04.039
    | text      = Arrakis.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:05.039
    | text      = Of course.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:06.039
    | text      = Now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:07.039
    | text      = Here's where I get fucked up about that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:08.039
    | text      = Where?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:09.039
    | text      = You know what exists at the same time as bagpipes?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:10.039
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:11.039
    | text      = Fucking helicopters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:12.039
    | text      = That's true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:13.039
    | text      = So we end up with dragonfly machines in bagpipes in this universe, and it doesn't make sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:20.920
    | text      = It's infuriating.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:23.600
    | text      = If you're gonna have independent inventions, you can't also have the same inventions with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:28.600
    | text      = even less changes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:29.680
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:30.680
    | text      = It's not a variation of a bagpipe or something like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:34.800
    | text      = I do like the idea of, in this multiverse, we can change anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:38.800
    | text      = Any little aspect can be changed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:40.239
    | text      = But let me tell you something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:41.640
    | text      = The guy who invented the bagpipes...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:43.479
    | text      = Nailed it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:44.479
    | text      = That is the man who stays.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:46.079
    | text      = And it's like...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:47.079
    | text      = Fixed point in the universe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:48.399
    | text      = To quote Ryan Reynolds' character in Blade Trinity, just like a great white shark, he's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:53.060
    | text      = never had to evolve.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:54.060
    | text      = Uh-huh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:55.060
    | text      = He was born perfect, the bagpipe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:56.920
    | text      = Has never had to evolve into being a dragonfly bullshit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:03.399
    | text      = I do like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:05.119
    | text      = It's fine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:06.119
    | text      = It was just a little bit distracting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:07.119
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:08.119
    | text      = But I don't know what would have been.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:09.119
    | text      = It's not quite one guy vacuuming a giant pool of slime by himself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:12.640
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:13.640
    | text      = It's not that distracting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:14.640
    | text      = And it didn't sound good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:15.880
    | text      = So I mean, ultimately, the effect was good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:18.300
    | text      = It just was like...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:19.300
    | text      = That's very...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:20.300
    | text      = It felt anachronistic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:21.300
    | text      = That's what the future can do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:23.199
    | text      = It can make a bagpipe sound good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:25.720
    | text      = It took a bagpipe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:27.340
    | text      = It took tens of thousands of years to get there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:29.359
    | text      = You don't like a bagpipe?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:30.359
    | text      = I mean, a bagpipe can be elsewhere.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:33.199
    | text      = Wow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:35.079
    | text      = I've never been like, oh man, I missed bagpipes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:39.600
    | text      = If I lived in the future and somebody was bringing a bagpipe up, my reaction would be
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:45.359
    | text      = like, we didn't get helicopters, but bagpipes stuck around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:49.840
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:50.840
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:51.840
    | text      = Some people complain that the doors didn't have a bass player in it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:54.760
    | text      = That's not my complaint.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:55.760
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:56.760
    | text      = My complaint, no bagpipes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:57.760
    | text      = No bagpipes?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:58.760
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:59.760
    | text      = What else could have been approved with bagpipes?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:00.760
    | text      = Just about everything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:01.760
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:02.760
    | text      = Really.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:03.760
    | text      = Rolling Stones.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:04.760
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Bob Dylan.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Also Sprock Zarathustra.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 01:14:07.760
    | text      = Uh-huh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:08.760
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:09.760
    | text      = I think Chicago, the band.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:11.520
    | text      = Chicago, the band, or the city?

{{TranscriptBlock
